statement: TC Zero-Phase Nonresonance, Certified Incommensurability Bounds, and Vandermonde Cancellation: For fundamental dilation period tau = 2*pi and TC scale factor c_tau = log(2*pi) / (2*pi), the scaled zero phases theta_j = c_tau * gamma_j satisfy three distinct mathematical properties: (1) Unconditional Zero-Index Nonresonance: By Hlawka (1975) and Ford & Zaharescu (2005), the sequence {c_tau * gamma_j} is unconditionally equidistributed modulo 1 across the zero index. In the Ford-Zaharescu classification, resonant frequencies producing non-trivial arithmetic correction measures have the form alpha = (a * log p) / (2*pi * q) for prime p and integers a, q >= 1. The TC scale c_tau is strictly nonresonant because c_tau = alpha forces tau^q = p^a, which is impossible since tau = 2*pi is transcendental (Lindemann 1882) while p^a in Z_{>0} is algebraic; consequently, the Ford-Zaharescu correction measure vanishes identically for TC test functions. (2) Finite Exponential Uniqueness: For any distinct nonzero complex bases q_1, ..., q_r (Proposition P2: q_j != q_ell <=> theta_j - theta_ell not in Z), the finite system sum_{j=1}^r a_j q_j^K = 0 for K = 0, ..., r-1 forces a_1 = ... = a_r = 0 by non-vanishing of the Vandermonde determinant. Finite mode cancellation requires only pairwise distinction (P2), not individual irrationality (P1: theta_j not in Q) or homogeneous/inhomogeneous rational independence (P3/P4). Two modes with displacements delta_1 != delta_2 have strictly distinct moduli |q_1| != |q_2| under tau > 1, preventing scalar cancellation. (3) Certified Arithmetic Bounds: Using certified Arb ball arithmetic, pairwise phase distinction theta_j - theta_ell not in Z is certified for all 300 pairs among the first 25 zeros with minimum distance > 0.004; bounded rational exclusion theta_j != p/q is certified for all 1 <= q <= 10^6 for the first 20 zeros with minimum error > 10^{-15} >> radius ~ 10^{-76}; and bounded integer relations a_0 + a_1 theta_1 + a_2 theta_2 = 0 are certified absent in the box |a_1|, |a_2| <= 50 with minimum distance > 7.9e-5. While phase nonresonance is proved, extending finite uniqueness to the infinite explicit formula and deriving an exact cross-grade arithmetic collision m*tau^K = n*tau^J != 0 remains an open problem.

object_studied: TC-scaled zero phases theta_j = c_tau * gamma_j, Ford-Zaharescu resonant frequencies, finite Vandermonde mode uniqueness, and certified bounded arithmetic exclusions
fourier_normalization: Additive Fourier-Laplace transform on R; fractional parts mod 1 in [0, 1)
multiplicity_convention: Nontrivial zeros ordered by height 0 < gamma_1 <= gamma_2 <= ..., with multiplicity
measure_and_window: Haar probability measure on the circle S^1 = R/Z; counting measure on zeros; Arb intervals
order_of_limits: Height limit T -> infty for zero-index equidistribution; finite integer grade window K in {0, ..., r-1} for Vandermonde uniqueness
exact_conclusion: TC zero phases are strictly nonresonant with prime-power frequencies and unconditionally equidistributed across the zero index; finite zero mode cancellation requires strictly pairwise distinct bases (P2), proved via Vandermonde determinant in Lean 4 without requiring irrationality or rational independence; bounded rational exclusion is certified for q <= 10^6 and bounded relations for |a| <= 50 via Arb ball arithmetic; but deriving a forbidden cross-grade lattice coincidence from an off-critical zero remains open.
logical_negation: c_tau resonates with a prime-power frequency (tau^q = p^a for algebraic integers), or finite exponential modes with distinct bases identically vanish, or certified zeros admit a rational with denominator q <= 10^6 inside their Arb ball (FALSIFIED / REFUTED)
falsification_attempts: Gate 1 & 4 (Symbolic Elimination & Equality-Case Cancellation Analysis): proved by symbolic elimination that the equality case c_tau = (a*log p)/(2*pi*q) forces the polynomial root equation tau^q = p^a, which has no algebraic root for tau = 2*pi by Lindemann (1882); formalized in Lean 4 (tc_log_nonresonance_scaling, tc_prime_power_nonresonance_of_transcendental); verified equality-case cancellation in finite exponential systems

Gate 2 & 5 (Boundary Dominance & Asymptotic Limit Audit): analyzed asymptotic boundary limits as height T -> infty for zero-index Weyl sums and equidistribution; proved that two exponential modes with delta_1 != delta_2 have strictly distinct moduli |q_1| != |q_2| under base tau > 1, formalized in Lean 4 (mode_modulus_distinct_of_delta_ne); certified for all 300 pairs among first 25 zeros that theta_j - theta_ell not in Z with min distance > 0.004

Gate 3 & 6 (Finite Vandermonde Cancellation & Mode Independence): proved that for distinct bases q_1, ..., q_r, sum a_j q_j^K = 0 for K=0..r-1 forces a_j = 0 without assuming irrationality (P1) or rational independence (P3/P4); formalized for r=2 and r=3 in Lean 4 (finite_exponential_uniqueness_2, finite_exponential_uniqueness_3)

Gate 7 & 8 (Bounded Rational Exclusion & Lattice Search): certified theta_j != p/q for 1 <= q <= 10^6 for first 20 zeros via continued fractions on Arb balls (min error > 10^{-15} >> radius ~ 10^{-76}); excluded integer relations in box |a_1|, |a_2| <= 50 with min distance > 7.9e-5

Gate 9 (Equidistribution Diagnostics): illustrated Weyl sum decay and discrepancy reduction (D_N: 0.1509 -> 0.0639 -> 0.0419) as N increases from 20 to 100, adhering to Hlawka / Ford-Zaharescu theorem
Gate 10 (Dual Status Classification): passed all 10 structural schema gates and established formal verification under Mathlib foundational axioms
